questions.question_english: Which option among the following accurately describes the legal status of an officer whose assistance is sought by a PIO under Section 5(4) of the RTI Act?
options_english: The assisting officer shall be treated as a PIO for penal provisions.
The assisting officer remains completely immune from any penal provisions under the Act.
The assisting officer automatically assumes the position of the First Appellate Authority.
The assisting officer can legally refuse to assist the PIO without providing valid reasons.
questions.explanation_english: The assisting officer shall be treated as a PIO for penal provisions. Section 5(5) explicitly provides that any officer whose assistance is sought by a Public Information Officer under Section 5(4) shall be treated as a Public Information Officer for the purpose of any contravention of the Act. Consequently, assisting officers bear direct legal liability for delays or improper refusals under penal provisions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है: सहायता देने वाले अधिकारी को दंडात्मक प्रावधानों के लिए PIO माना जाएगा। सही विकल्प अधिनियम के प्रमाण-भार, PIO की जिम्मेदारी और दंड संबंधी प्रावधानों से निर्धारित होता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)
Correct option (English): The assisting officer shall be treated as a PIO for penal provisions.

questions.question_english: According to Section 25 of the RTI Act, who prepares the annual report on the implementation of the provisions of the RTI Act?
options_english: The Central Information Commission or State Information Commission
The Department of Personnel and Training under the Ministry of Personnel
The Prime Minister’s Office supervising central administrative reforms
The NITI Aayog acting through its public governance evaluation wing
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option (a). Section 25(1) mandates that the Central Information Commission and State Information Commissions prepare annual reports on the implementation of the Act’s provisions. These reports document compliance metrics, statistics on applications, fee collections, penalties, and operational recommendations across all public authorities falling within their jurisdiction during that year.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। धारा 25(1) के अनुसार, केंद्रीय सूचना आयोग और राज्य सूचना आयोग को RTI अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के कार्यान्वयन पर वार्षिक रिपोर्ट तैयार करनी होती है। ये रिपोर्ट अनुपालन मेट्रिक्स, आवेदनों पर सांख्यिकी, शुल्क संग्रह, दंड और उस वर्ष के दौरान उनके अधिकार क्षेत्र में आने वाले सभी सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरणों के लिए संचालन संबंधी सिफारिशें दस्तावेजित करती हैं।
key_facts: Section 25(1) mandates annual reports by CIC and SIC.

questions.explanation_english: Section 2(h) of the Right to Information Act defines a public authority as any authority, body, or institution of self-government established by or under the Constitution, by parliamentary or state law, or by government notification. questions.question_english: A Principal (PIO) receives an RTI from a commercial vendor asking for the technical specifications of smartboards purchased by the school, along with the competitive bid documents of the vendor’s rivals. The rival vendors had submitted these bids under a seal of commercial confidence. What is the most appropriate action?
options_english: Issue notice under Section 11 for third-party views and evaluate Section 8(1)(d) exemptions.
Disclose all competitive bid documents immediately to promote full transparency in school procurement processes.
Refuse the requested tender details outright by citing strategic national security exemptions under Section 8(1)(a).
Transfer the RTI application directly to the designated GeM portal administrator for appropriate administrative handling.
questions.explanation_english: When commercial tender documents submitted by rival vendors under trade secrecy are requested, the Public Information Officer must issue notice under Section 11 to obtain third-party representations. The officer evaluates whether commercial confidence exemption under Section 8(1)(d) applies or whether competitive harm is outweighed by demonstrated public interest.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जब प्रतिद्वंद्वी विक्रेताओं द्वारा व्यापार गोपनीयता के तहत प्रस्तुत किए गए व्यावसायिक निविदा दस्तावेजों की मांग की जाती है, तो जन सूचना अधिकारी को तीसरे पक्ष के विचार प्राप्त करने के लिए धारा 11 के तहत नोटिस जारी करना चाहिए। अधिकारी यह मूल्यांकन करता है कि क्या धारा 8(1)(d) के तहत व्यावसायिक गोपनीयता की छूट लागू होती है या प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक नुकसान प्रदर्शित सार्वजनिक हित से अधिक है।
key_facts: Section 11 mandates notice for third-party views.
Section 8(1)(d) provides exemptions for commercial confidence.
Public interest may outweigh competitive harm.
Printed answer key: (A) Issue notice under Section 11 for third-party views and evaluate Section 8(1)(d) exemptions.
